name: Pingo
subtitle: Games for Messages
promotionalText: Challenge friends to 22 quick games directly inside Messages, from 8-Ball and Chess to Bowling, Trivia, Word Hunt, Mini Racing, and more.
description:
Pingo is a collection of competitive two-player games built specifically for Apple Messages. Pick a game, send a challenge in the conversation, take your turn, and send the updated Pingo card back.

PLAY 22 GAMES
Choose from 8-Ball, Cup Pong, Basketball, Darts, Mini Golf, Sea Battle, Chess, Checkers, Connect Four, Tic-Tac-Toe, Bowling, Penalty Shootout, Archery, Air Hockey, Draw & Guess, Word Hunt, Anagrams, Trivia, Crazy Eights, Ludo, Mini Racing, and Reaction Battle.

BUILT FOR IMESSAGE
Pingo lives inside Messages. Challenges, turns, rematches, and Best-of series stay in the conversation so there is no separate social network to manage.

COMPETE YOUR WAY
Play a single game or a Best of 3 or Best of 5 series. Track wins, losses, draws, streaks, XP, levels, achievements, match history, and friend records.

MAKE IT YOURS
Unlock optional one-time game expansion packs and cosmetic packs. Pingo has no coins, loot boxes, wagering, or real-money gambling mechanics. Restore eligible purchases from the Pingo Store at any time.

PRIVACY FIRST
Pingo does not use advertising or cross-app tracking. Gameplay and profile data are used to provide matches, progression, and account functionality.
